scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name domain-manager-4j0 --branch production
scripts.pages:dev: wrangler pages dev --compatibility-date=2024-01-01 --d1=DB -- npm run dev
scripts.db:inspect:remote: wrangler d1 execute domains-db --remote --command "SELECT name FROM sqlite_schema WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name;"
scripts.db:backup:remote: mkdir -p backups && wrangler d1 export domains-db --remote --output=./backups/domains-db.sql
scripts.db:verify:remote: wrangler d1 execute domains-db --remote --command "SELECT name FROM sqlite_schema WHERE type='table' AND name IN ('domains','adsense_accounts','adsense_income','provider_accounts','provider_resources','domain_resources','provider_credentials','domain_ai_notes','domain_ai_note_versions','domain_operations');"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --branch production
scripts.deploy:full: npm run build && npm run db:execute && wrangler pages deploy dist --branch production
scripts.dev:local: npm run db:local && npm run pages:dev
